acceptance: A new job in .github/workflows/verify-deployment.yml runs `python3 scripts/skillspector_scan.py` on pull requests to main and passes on the PR #118 head (link the run); the existing job's steps are unchanged and it passes.
The scanner is checked out at the full pinned SHA and installed with `uv sync --frozen` from its uv.lock; uv itself is pinned to an exact version; no floating tag, branch or `latest` for the scanner.

Every `uses:` in the new job is pinned to a full commit SHA; the job sets `persist-credentials: false`, `timeout-minutes`, and `permissions: contents: read`; the trigger stays `pull_request` (never `pull_request_target`); the job uses no secret and makes no LLM call.

The script exits nonzero when: a finding is not covered by a baseline; a baseline entry suppresses nothing (stale); a baseline names an untracked skill; a baseline contains a `rules` entry or the auto-generated default reason; the scanner version differs from the pin; a scan is incomplete or fails; or zero skills are scanned. It prints the tracked and scanned counts.

Negative proof on a throwaway copy: adding an instruction to read `~/.codex/config.toml` to skills/blog/SKILL.md (a file with no baseline entry) makes the script exit nonzero and name that file, line and rule; removing one baseline entry's finding (stale entry) also fails. Nothing from the throwaway copy is committed.
No `continue-on-error`, no `|| true`, no path filter on the job.

README.md documents: the local command and install; how to bump the pin; that a baseline must be regenerated, and its reasons rewritten from docs/skillspector-triage.md, after an edit to a flagged file or a pin bump; and that the gate covers only skills/ in this repository. The documented local command, run verbatim against the PR head, exits 0.

description: Nothing stops a new skill or edit from introducing a hidden instruction, an exfiltration pattern or an overbroad permission. Owner decision: gate pull requests on a static SkillSpector scan pinned to commit 9dc82fe473329b2b742aa5097dcfe7ae55f51b01. One script (scripts/skillspector_scan.py, standard library only) scans each tracked skill separately with `--no-llm` and its baseline, and is the single entry point for CI and for local use. Pinning the scanner commit alone does not pin its dependencies, and fingerprints depend on scanner output, so the install uses the scanner's own uv.lock. main has no branch protection, so the job reports but cannot block a merge until the owner makes it a required check.
